CVE-2016-7165 has been assigned to this vulnerability. MITIGATIONS If the affected products are installed under their default path (“C:\Program Files\*” or the localized equivalent) and the default file system access permissions for drive C:\ were not modified, the security vulnerability is not exploitable. However, if the affected products are not installed under their default path (“C:\Program Files\*” or the localized equivalent), the security vulnerability is potentially exploitable.
